claims.description: Trace of the later-phases path: webServer defined once at config root, shared by every project; later-phases project block adds no env override, so project selection has zero effect on which flag values reach the export.

Environment materialization: applyExpoPublicEnvOverrides replace-or-appends EXPO_PUBLIC_ENABLE_MODE_NAV + V1 + V2 (+ E2E) from the invoking shell into the env files Expo reads before web export — the effective values are proven by this code path, not inferred from the project name.
Already Fixed ancestor: the wiring landed in this commit (2026-06-21) and is byte-present at the current execution base; verified reachable from origin/main via merge-base ancestry.
Regression coverage for the wiring ran locally with zero failures via the node test runner.

No gap found, so no source change was made; the maintained later-phases invocations are the two README commands, both already exporting all three values true, and the explicit V0/V1 matrix commands outside the release project are preserved.

Config-level verification only: the helper regression test asserts the V2 key is written true into the env file; no seeded Playwright web run executed, no credential-bearing artifact generated (WI-2593 redaction gate honored).

Completion evidence names the outcome (Already Fixed), the ancestor commit, every maintained invocation checked (e2e-web.yml smoke lanes enumeration + README commands), and the safe non-credential verification command (the node --test run above).
